scientific_assessment.local: J_i=F_i+alpha_i<h_i,w>+(alpha_i/2)||w-x||^2; gradient gradF_i+alpha_i*(w-x+h_i). Shifted and author linear-plus-decay forms differ only by a parameter-independent constant when clipping is inactive.
scientific_assessment.paper_mapping: For the common-alpha scaled objective, paper signed local state g_i=-alpha*h_i and server state=-alpha*mean_population(h_i). Algorithm1 therefore gives selected unweighted endpoint mean plus full-population displacement-history mean.
scientific_assessment.weighting: Uniform default q=1. Sample q_i=N*n_i/sum(n), alpha_i=alpha/q_i. Scaled-loss/learning-rate interpretation is an algebraic inference, not a new finite-SGD convergence theorem. No sample weighting of selected endpoints, no selected-only count normalization, no label-derived coefficient.
